Rush_owner_snapshots.evidence_boundary: T-1 owner5 engine applies to original Rush only if owner source shows same hull, and still does not independently prove retained engine after capture. Sabers seen at T-1 are historical locations, not necessarily active at VCR start. A postcombat hull35 with the same ID cannot be treated as the same physical ship.

boundary: The same Rush ship ID/hull changes observed owner across VCR starts and is CONSISTENT with capture; capture success itself is not proven without combat terminal/ship ownership event evidence. Ship ID27's postcombat Victorious hull35 is not assumed continuous with the Rush hull94. Static T-1 observations are controls, not a generative Host static resolver or verified precombat unit state.
